summary: Verified StrictMode double-consume fix for Emergent Google OAuth callback. Playwright intercepted network requests while navigating to /dashboard#session_id=probe_test_123 and observed EXACTLY 1 POST to /api/auth/google/session (previously 2). Backend returns graceful 401 on bogus session_id, callback shows failure state and auto-redirects to /login within ~2s. Google outbound redirect points to auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/. Email/password regression fully green: 13/13 pytest cases pass (login → access_token, /me valid/invalid, google_session invalid graceful 401, minted JWT accepted, receipts). UI email login lands on /dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthCallback.js uses module-level Set to guard session_id — correct pattern for StrictMode idempotency; entry is deleted on catch so a retry after failure is still possible.
Backend google/session caches successful exchanges for ~5 min (idempotent) and returns 401 on invalid, 502 on network error — matches spec.
Google outbound URL correctly built from window.location.origin with no hardcoded redirect fallback (per auth_testing.md warning).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The critical proof for this iteration: instrument page.on('request') filtering '/api/auth/google/session' and navigate to /dashboard#session_id=<any>. Must observe EXACTLY 1 POST despite React.StrictMode. Fix implemented via module-level Set(sid) in AuthCallback.js. Backend graceful invalid path returns 401 (accepted set: 400/401/502).
rca of the issue: Original: React.StrictMode double-mounts components in dev; the useRef guard in AuthCallback got a fresh instance on the 2nd mount, so /api/auth/google/session was POSTed twice with the same single-use session_id. Upstream (demobackend.emergentagent.com/auth/v1/env/oauth/session-data) consumed the id on the 1st call, returned 404 user_data_not_found on the 2nd, and the surface error was 'Google sign-in failed'. Mitigation verified: (1) module-level Set survives StrictMode remount; (2) backend also caches a successful exchange for ~5 min so even a race can't double-fail. Playwright confirmed exactly 1 network call in dev-mode StrictMode.
